note: English corrections only; the date schema is unchanged. The input exposes one English field per unit (units[].en); no other English copies of these units were present.

replacements.problem: Omits the Jin titles 驃騎大將軍、遼西公 and the phrase 雅好人物/虛心延裕.
replacements.before: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.
replacements.after: At that time the Xianbei chanyu Duan Juan, who held the Jin titles of General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi, had a refined fondness for men of talent and humbly invited Yang Yu.

replacements.problem: 司馬 is mistranslated as "chief clerk", and 以左丞領 and the title 征東 are omitted.
replacements.before: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
replacements.after: When Duan Liao asked Shi Jilong to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while Left Assistant of the Secretariat, concurrently served as Sima to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.

replacements.problem: Omits the speaker Shaoyou (少遊), and 郡掾/國相 are mistranslated as "county post"/"chancellor" without the attribution.
replacements.before: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.
replacements.after: Shaoyou said that a post as commandery clerk was enough to shelter one's descendants; how much more the post of chancellor of a state!
